newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas sprints to further record profits.
newsitem.headline: Adidas sprints to further record profits.

text.p: German sportswear maker Adidas AG said on Thursday that it expected first quarter 1997 pre-tax profits would total at least 235 million marks ($136.4 million), while sales grew in all its markets.
In a separate announcement, Adidas said that one of its major shareholders, France's Sogedim SA, which owns 26.1 percent of the group's capital, would put that stake up for sale.
The combination of the two announcements lifted Adidas shares and it was among the top performing shares on the IBIS DAX index of electronic trade in German shares over the day.
Adidas ended up 7.10 marks, or 3.99 percent, at 185 marks, outperforming the overall IBIS DAX-30 index which ended down 12.18 points, or 0.36 percent, at 3,352.58 points.
As an exporting stock, the strength of the dollar against the mark, at around 1.72 marks, also supported the share.
Continued growth in sales of the group's sports shoes and sports clothing saw turnover in the first three months grow by 43 percent to 1.7 billion marks, Adidas said.
Sales were up 31 percent in Europe, 75 percent in the United States, while income from Asian/Pacific markets doubled from the previous year.

Demand for trainers, tennis shoes and leisure footwear, known for their distinctive three-stripe logo, was "clearly higher" Adidas said, while its sports clothing division grew by 57 percent last year.

Regarding the sale of the Sogedim shareholding, Adidas' chief executive Robert Louis-Dreyfus and management board member Christian Tourres, have agreed to purchase 2,950,000 shares each through the offering.
This wil give Louis-Dreyfus 6.5 percent of Adidas capital. The remaining 5,938,000 shares would be offered to other investors, Adidas said.

The shares will be offered to institutional investors worldwide and retail investors in Germany following an accelerated global tender with UBS Limited acting as a global coordinator and bookrunner together with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation, UBS said.
A syndicate will be formed and the price for the shares is expected to be announced on April 16. Marketing and bookbuilding began on Thursday.
